messages.subject: pileup2seqz: -C / --chromosome options (just as for bam2seqz)
parts:
Hi,

I've already got pileup files (which I want to keep) and I'd like to run pileup2seqz chromosome by chromosome on these for parallelization (but also to work around  https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/sequenza-user-group/vt301ea1_lg).  However, as far as I understand this option is only available for bam2seqz, or?

Thxs,

Henrik

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: pileup2seqz: -C / --chromosome options (just as for bam2seqz)
parts:
Hi Henrik,

Unfortunately only the bam2seqz implement the lookup by coordinate feature. This because it uses the "samtools view" options.

It is possible however tocreate a binary index of a pileup with tabix, and then query a given position in a similar way then samtools does.

I'm not going to implement in the near future this functionality out of the box in pileup2seqz, but it's possible to use the command in pipes with others. So it is already possible to achieve a similar result.
I suggest to use named pipes (fifo files) if you want to try it. If you need help I will try to set up an example that you can follow

Best

Francesco
